Prices charged as of
1st January 2026


Please note : I give free quotations and I do not charge a callout fee, however, I do have a minimum charge of £40.00 for any work that I do, even if it only takes a few minutes.

First hour - £70.00

subsequent hours are charged at £45.00 /hour

2 hours - £115.00
3 hours - £160.00
4 hours - £205.00
5 hours - £250.00
6 hours - £295.00
7 hours - £340.00

1 day - £385.00


Gutter clearing £110 to £190 for most houses.
Usually work is charged on an hourly/daily rate.
However, some work will be charged at an agreed set price which will only change if unforseen cicumstances occur.
Some jobs, for example gutter clearing, are always charged at a higher rate due to the dangers involved with ladders.
There are always unseen costs involved in travelling to your home to do work. These consist of fuel/vehicle costs, time spent loading/unloading of tools and materials, time spent sourcing materials needed, travelling time across town to your home and back. These costs are the same whether I spend half an hour at your home or all day there. This is why the first hour (or part of) is charged at a higher rate than subsequent hours. To save money, I recommend that you save up several small jobs before calling me out.

Time starts at my arrival at your home.

Materials used are charged at cost.
No VAT or Hidden extras.
Payment due on completion by Cash, Bank Transfer or Cheque.
Please make cheques payable to:
Chesterfield Aquatics.
